title: Text: DET John Westhoff ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What is a memo of understanding? Curious because of the Greg Schiano stuff. Is that essentially a contract?
Tentative agreement subject to a more formal contract
So can he demand money for Tennessee to break it? Or file a lawsuit? And do you guys do those with free agent signings?
Don't know in his case. Our deals subject to passing a physical and agreeing on guarantee language.
Just wondering. Wasn’t sure what the memo was. Figured it had some kind of purpose
